dataset.name: Electronic filing listings
dataset.description: OpenFEC listing assertions for electronic files posted as received, retained at API-page and file-number grain.

acquisition.pagination: Offset pages starting at 1 with per_page=100. Preserve every page envelope. A closed overlapped receipt-date query is complete only after every advertised page is present, result count equals the exact advertised count, and two complete passes converge on the same file-number set and per-file listing content.

partitions.name: efile_received_date
partitions.source: Calendar date parsed from receipt_date after acquisition through an overlapped publisher date query.
partitions.purpose: Daily raw-filing discovery. Null or unparsable receipt dates enter an explicit unassigned partition and never disappear.

partitions.name: listing_observation
partitions.source: Legal Tender retrieval timestamp plus request parameters, response headers, and response-body SHA-256 for each page.
partitions.purpose: Preserve mutable amendment and most-recent assertions independently of filing receipt time.

acquisition.retry_policy: Retry bounded transient HTTP and rate-limit responses using publisher headers and jitter. Preserve failed page attempts. Never publish an empty or partial interval after an error, an inexact count, a missing page, duplicate conflict, or failed convergence pass.

physical_schema.empty_record_policy: Every object in results becomes a listing occurrence or an explicit issue. An empty complete interval is retained with its page envelope and convergence evidence.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve absent, null, empty-string, false, zero, and empty-array states independently. No source timestamp gains an inferred timezone.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: OpenFEC EFilings result fields and pagination envelope captured from Swagger SHA-256 b933e5ba144a9b3b63b19b902e7ad4d4032507022826d93ddde6dca5918b9485.

identity.occurrence_locator: listing page response SHA-256 + zero-based results ordinal
identity.record_version: file_number + SHA-256 of the complete canonical listing object + listing observation timestamp
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every page occurrence. Equal file numbers with equal content deduplicate only in a named interval index; conflicting content remains separate versioned listing assertions and blocks interval completion until reviewed.

time_fields.meaning: Publisher electronic-filing receipt timestamp without an explicit timezone; the raw text remains authoritative.
Publisher filing calendar date, independent of receipt and load timestamps.
Publisher load timestamp without an explicit timezone; not filing or transaction time.
Report coverage start asserted by the listing.
Report coverage end asserted by the listing.
Legal Tender API observation time and transport evidence.

code_fields.meaning: Publisher filing form code, including new, amendment, or termination suffix when supplied.
Publisher display identifier for this file; not the same field as the amendment report ID inside HDR.
Publisher document-image range, retained as opaque text.

rules: Capture every form type returned for the discovery interval; parser support never narrows source acquisition.
The API's date filter is only a discovery boundary. Assign daily partitions from the preserved receipt_date and use overlap so endpoint boundary behavior cannot lose a filing.
A file number identifies one publisher filing. It does not identify a report family, real-world transaction, or effective report.

amends_file, amended_by, amendment_chain, amendment_number, is_amended, most_recent, and most_recent_filing are separate publisher assertions. Preserve all of them even when they appear incomplete or inconsistent.
is_amended describes whether this listed filing has been superseded in the observed projection; it must not be interpreted as 'this filing is an amendment'.
A listing fetched by predecessor file number can expose a shorter amendment_chain than its successor. Never treat one listing object's chain array as proof of family closure.
Never infer an effective filing from form_type or most_recent alone. A versioned report-family calculation owns that decision.
The fec_url selects the exact as-filed acquisition lane. csv_url, pdf_url, and html_url are independent publisher representations and cannot replace those bytes without separate contracts.
Keep receipt, filed, load, report coverage, observation, document publication, and transaction dates independent.

revisions.publisher_model: The listing endpoint presents files as received and mutable relationship projections. Later amendments can change predecessor fields such as amended_by, is_amended, most_recent, most_recent_filing, and observed amendment_chain without changing the predecessor file number.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. Preserve every observed listing version and exact referenced filing. Effective report families are a separate calculation contract and never rewrite listing history.

checks.rule: Every accepted response conforms to page.schema.json; unknown fields are captured and require contract review.
pagination.is_count_exact is true, every page from 1 through pages is present, and the distinct occurrence count agrees with pagination.count.
Two complete passes over the same closed overlapped query yield identical file-number sets and per-file content before the interval is complete.
Every result has a positive file_number and conflicting content for one file number remains versioned evidence rather than last-write-wins input.
Every result becomes one received-date occurrence, one explicit overlap duplicate, or one unassigned-date issue.
The acquired .fec document retains the listing file_number, fec_url, listing version, and content digest.
Missing predecessors, successor disagreement, cycles, and asymmetric chain assertions remain explicit report-family issues.
OpenFEC listing timestamps omit an offset in the observed schema; raw values remain timezone-unresolved until publisher semantics are pinned.

scenarios: predecessor chain array omits observed successor
successor chain contains original and amendment
is_amended false on an amendment not yet superseded

use.retention: Retain every exact response page, request parameters without credentials, response headers, response digest, observation time, parsed listing occurrence, and convergence result indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: Electronic-filing listings are publisher discovery and relationship assertions. They do not establish that a filing is the legally effective report or that its transaction rows are processed FEC data.
